insertText.text: 1:10–1:45. WILLINGNESS-TO-PAY RESULT. Each dot is one real visitor; coral dots clicked checkout. 213 visitors, 9 checkout clicks: 4.2%, well under our 10% bar. By price, checkout rates were 2.7% at $129, 4.7% at $169 and 5.3% at $199. 4 of the 9 left an email for the waitlist. What we changed because of this: we removed the price question nobody answered, rebuilt the out-of-stock screen around the waitlist, and added a Show more section and session replays so we can see where people drop off. Data: Nov 12–20 (as of Nov 20, 10:48 PM).

3:00–3:35. CUSTOMER ACQUISITION RESULT. Paid ads brought 148 of our 213 visitors, about 69% of the traffic, and not one added to cart. Organic Instagram, people who came through the link in our bio, brought 43 visitors and 9 checkout clicks: 20.9%. Other sources brought 22 visitors and 0 checkout clicks. So a cold audience scrolling past an ad does not buy a $169 bracelet on first sight, but people who already follow us do click. What we changed: we moved the shop to a clean link, wearfirefly, because the old one showed a personal GitHub name; we set up a live dashboard that splits every visit by ad and channel; and we are moving effort from cold ads to warm channels. Data: Nov 12–20 (as of Nov 20, 10:48 PM). FILL IN the ad spend from Instagram before presenting.
